verdict.rationale: Model-fit guidance before download is a fair question for a local inference engine, so the axis applies. The evidence pack documents hardware support, quantization, model architecture coverage and benchmarking. None of it shows an AI assistant or recommender that suggests which model fits a user's hardware and task before download.

support.subject: As an ai-native user, I can rely on an AI assistant to recommend which local model best fits my hardware and task before I download it
